facts.text: I need to write a statement of faith about my church.
My church is an Evangelical church.
My church holds on to traditional Evangelical teachings.
My statement of faith should cover topics about the Scriptures.
My statement of faith should cover topics about the Triune God.
My statement of faith should cover topics about Jesus Christ.
My statement of faith should cover topics about the Holy Spirit.
My statement of faith should cover topics about Man.
My statement of faith should cover topics about Salvation.
My statement of faith should cover topics about the Church.
My statement of faith should cover topics about the Things to Come.
